title: SOMA Auth: enable LinkedIn sign-in
_note: Pass --param CLIENT_ID=<LinkedIn app Client ID> (public). The secret is never prefilled or read; Mike pastes it from LinkedIn's Copy button.

steps.instruction: Turn on LinkedIn (OIDC) enabled (the first switch at the top of this panel).
Paste the LinkedIn Primary Client Secret from your clipboard into Client Secret.
Yeshie filled in the Client ID from your LinkedIn app (it starts 86xlg). Check it, then click Save.
